summary: Southern Cross Acquisition II Corp., a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering of 7,652,630 units at $10.00 per unit, including partial exercise of the underwriters' over-allotment option, generating gross proceeds of $76.5 million. Concurrently, it completed a private placement of 224,932 units to its sponsor and the underwriter representative for $2.25 million. Net proceeds of $76.7 million were deposited into a trust account with Equiniti Trust Company. This is a routine IPO disclosure, not a special situation. What to watch: the company's search for an initial business combination within its mandated timeframe.
